title: Manga Platform — Service Health
description: Request rate, latency, and errors per service. Import via Dashboards > Import.

panels.title: Requests / sec by service
panels.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1m') AS t, service_name, count(*) AS rps FROM "default" WHERE type = 'metric' GROUP BY t, service_name ORDER BY t

panels.title: p95 latency (ms) by service
panels.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1m') AS t, service_name, approx_percentile(duration, 0.95) AS p95 FROM "default" GROUP BY t, service_name ORDER BY t

panels.title: Error rate (5xx) by service
panels.query: SELECT service_name, count(*) AS errors FROM "manga-logs" WHERE status >= 500 GROUP BY service_name ORDER BY errors DESC

panels.title: Slowest traces (top 10)
panels.query: SELECT trace_id, service_name, operation_name, duration FROM "default" ORDER BY duration DESC LIMIT 10
